zelda.title: Princess
zelda.name: Zelda
zelda.backstory: The princess of a kingdom of seven sages beyond the western mountains, whose realm once fell under a strange twilight. Zelda travels under a hooded cloak, carries herself like a queen anyway, and is studying how a business this odd stays solvent.

design.hairStyle: very long, with two wrapped side locks
design.gear: long white gloves with a triangle crest

sig_zelda.label: Royal gown
sig_zelda.prompt: a regal white and lavender gown with a royal-crest tabard, ornate gold shoulder pieces and long white gloves

sp_zelda.label: Twilight cloak
sp_zelda.prompt: a black hooded cloak over a fitted white and gold gown

midna.note: An unlikely alliance from the twilight days.

unique.name: Wisdom
unique.desc: A princess's sharp mind and graceful bearing.

midna.name: Midna
midna.title: Queen
midna.backstory: The rightful queen of a realm of twilight, Midna spent a long stretch cursed into a tiny imp and enjoyed none of it. Back in her true form, she is tall, imperious and wickedly amused by everything, Sam very much included.

design.skin: pale blue-grey with glowing teal markings

sig_midna.label: Twilight robe
sig_midna.prompt: a flowing black and white robe with glowing teal geometric patterns, open at the sides

sp_midna.label: Imp cloak
sp_midna.prompt: a short black hooded cloak with teal markings over almost nothing

zelda.note: An unlikely alliance from the twilight days.

unique.name: Twilight Mischief
unique.desc: Playful and magnetic, with a knack for getting what she wants.

malon.name: Malon
malon.backstory: A rancher from a kingdom of seven sages beyond the western mountains who sings to her horses and has opinions about milk. Malon came to sell her family's dairy to the house bar and ended up running it.

design.gear: a horse-head brooch at her collar

sig_malon.label: Rancher's dress
sig_malon.prompt: a white peasant blouse, a long lilac skirt, a yellow neckerchief and a white apron

sp_malon.label: Festival dress
sp_malon.prompt: a red and cream ruffled festival dress with flowers in her hair

unique.name: Lon Lon Songs
unique.desc: Her rancher's songs cheer a room.

great_fairy.name: Cotera
great_fairy.backstory: Cotera, a great fairy, used to live in a healing fountain and grant weary travelers their strength back. She has moved into the bathhouse, which she considers a fountain with better gossip, and her laugh echoes off the tiles.

design.features: green ivy-like markings across her body and tiny gossamer wings

sig_great_fairy.label: Ivy and gold
sig_great_fairy.prompt: strands of living green ivy and slim gold armbands and anklets

sp_great_fairy.label: Petal gown
sp_great_fairy.prompt: a sheer gown woven from flower petals and ivy

great_fairy.title: Great Fairy

nabooru.name: Nabooru
nabooru.backstory: A desert warrior-thief and sage from a clan of women, Nabooru only ever stole from people who deserved it. She says the house security job is a vacation. Nobody has tried her.

design.features: a jeweled forehead piece and heavy gold hoop earrings

sig_nabooru.label: Desert thief's silks
sig_nabooru.prompt: loose white harem pants, a short white top, a red sash and gold jewelry

sp_nabooru.label: Sage's regalia
sp_nabooru.prompt: an ornate gold and white desert gown with a jeweled belt

unique.name: Thief's Pride
unique.desc: She can spot a hustle a mile away.
